headline: SAME-HOUR: APH is held on 48 SERVED minted days (1 account, 48 account-days, 2025-02-11 to 2025-04-21). Its served close is 0.50 of the store (0.5035 to 0.5048) and 0.487 of the price paid: a split-sized error in the served price. It is not in the 47 partitions. Cause not established: no build/store step equals a split ratio. CTVA: served 115 account-days at 0.15 of the store, not an integer split size; the store matches the price paid, the build does not. HON: build and store differ by 5 to 17 percent with no split step; the price paid favours the build on 2023-2025 trades and the store on 2026-02-04. KLAC and SCCO: no held day on which the build, store or served copy carries a price. C-BASIS does not widen: no cause is double_scaling.
not_established: vendor split dates for all five: the cache files carry no split events, the build split plan is not on disk in r34/after/, and the split store was not read (grant); vendor_splits is empty for that reason, not because none exist

whether any build/store step equals a split ratio on a split date: none does in any overlap, so no double_scaling is named; the APH and CTVA level factors are flat from the first common day, so any split behind them lies before the store window or after 2026-06-05
KLAC and SCCO: no held day with a build or store row, so the price paid cannot test the build or the store there
HON held days in the window: minted copy 32 days (3 accounts), 47 partitions 9 days (2 accounts); not reconciled

the 47 partitions were matched by asset_name (pre-snapshot ticker column is empty; cache/holdings.parquet covers only from 2026-06-08); the four names absent from the partitions are absent under that match
post-store one-day steps in the build after 2026-06-05 (APH 2026-09-04 factor 0.517; CTVA 2026-10-02 factor 0.1535) are measured and not explained; the store does not reach them
the price paid is the custodian trade amount over units; intraday and limit effects of a few percent sit inside every comparison
